profile.headline: Software Developer at Lennar
profile.summary: Motivated and detail-oriented Software Engineer with hands-on experience in developing software solutions. Proficient in several programming languages, frameworks, and committed to writing clean, efficient code. Enthusiastic about collaborating with cross-functional teams to build innovative applications. Strong problem-solving skills and a continuous learner eager to grow in the fast-paced tech industry.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Launched the Road to Close Salesforce pilot and built a scalable state-specific template architecture for process variations, raising Customer Communicated Closing date completion from 12% to 70% and closing task list completion from 20% to 34% in ~7 weeks.
• Built two Claude skills, a PR-comparing fix tracker that catches lagging stories and an R2C data-model template manager that speeds up template creation and validation, while mentoring a summer intern through a Salesforce-wide risk assessment project.
• Selected by the CHRO for a small rapid-response team, built LLM-powered HR report automation in Palantir Foundry that securely turns images, transcripts, and structured data into standardized reports, cutting investigation time ~20%.
• Led a winning capstone delivering a data-driven automated scheduling solution, estimating 105,000+ labor hours saved annually and ~26% faster warranty resolution, and presented the approach to C-level leadership.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Lead the development of a feature enhancement project within the Salesforce environment to apply knowledge of the platform, software management, CI/CD Azure pipelines, flows, and Apex functionalities.
• Modify and improve Python scripts to handle data integration conflict regarding the entry of records and retrieval of information using Selenium to simulate browser traversal and user engagement for Web2Case function.
• Collaborate with experienced engineers and analysts to further develop and improve business processes within the internal platform using Jira, Slack, and Microsoft Teams.
positions.insights: Team Leadership, Software Development and +3 skills

positions.title: Sales Stock Associate
positions.description:
• Lead fulfillment of needs by the retail floor in a team to provide a complete customer experience.
• Ensure efficiency is maintained whilst processing items along the freight assembly line.
positions.insights: Team Leadership, Retail Sales and +2 skills

volunteerExperiences.description: Participated in the renovation and construction of a recreational area and rest stop at C.B. Smith Park.
Assisted the scouts in cleansing the mangroves of gathered trash due to the movement of tides at the Vizcaya Museum and Gardens.

projects.title: Job Query Scheduler
projects.description:
• Enhanced query scheduling service to include on-demand functionality and handle empty results using flows and invocable Apex for a desirable user experience.
• Engaged in project management through Atlassian Jira to professionally track progress and form user stories while following the software development lifecycle.
• Pushed contributions into production using GitHub and Azure pipeline from sandbox environment after incorporating the proper unit testing necessary to ensure a smooth transition to the platform.

projects.title: Bookstore RESTful API
projects.description:
• Utilized UML concepts to construct outline and establish product functionalities with elaborate definitions.
• Developed a RESTful API service for a bookstore using C#, SQL, and the .NET MVC Framework.
• Displays use of HTTP requests in various forms to insert, update, and remove items.
• Implemented the SCRUM workflow to collaborate and maximize team efficiency with a measured output.
